اقتلعوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَلَعُوا (iqtalaʕū) /iq.ta.la.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اُقْتُلِعُوا (uqtuliʕū) /uq.tu.li.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اِقْتَلِعُوا (iqtaliʕū) /iq.ta.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
